liebermann.description_de: Vorlage für I und L[ateinischen Übersetzer der Leis Wl]
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Posited by Liebermann: a common source of I (Pseudo-Ingulf) and the Latin translator L of the Leis Willelme, inferred from the readings they share. No such manuscript survives.
liebermann.notes: A common source of Leis Wl used, in Liebermann’s view, by I (Pseudo-Ingulf) and by the Latin translator L; posited by Liebermann.
